# Planner 5D

> Planner 5D is a comprehensive 2D/3D home and interior design platform with AI-powered tools, AR visualization, and professional features for both consumers and design professionals.

The platform offers web-based and mobile applications for creating floor plans, 3D room designs, and interior layouts. It includes advanced features like AI plan recognition, 360° virtual walkthroughs, mood board creation, and professional design services, supporting multiple file formats and operating systems.

## Key Topics

- 3D Visualization
- Home Design Software
- Interior Design Tool
- Floor Plan Creator
- AI Design Generator
- Room Planner
- AR Technology
- 4K Renders
- 360 Walkthrough
- Mobile App
- CAD Integration
- Furniture Catalog
- Project Sharing
- 3D Model Import
- Professional Design Services

## Core Design Tools

- [Planner 5D: House Design Software | Home Design in 3D](https://planner5d.com): Homepage showcasing Planner 5D's 2D/3D house design tool with AI and AR features
- [Create Design in a Room Planner Online - Planner 5D](https://planner5d.com/editor): Main online editor for 3D room design, floor plans, and instant design ideas
- [3D Floor Planner - Create 3D Floor Plans with Planner 5D](https://planner5d.com/use/3D-floor-plan): Advanced 3D floor planning tool for layout creation and visualization

## Professional Features & Services

- [Interior Design Software Solutions for Industry Professionals](https://planner5d.com/pro): Professional tier with AI sketching, 4K renders, CAD integration for designers
- [Convert Blueprint to 3D Model - Artificial Intelligence Plan Recognition | Planner 5D](https://planner5d.com/ai): AI plan recognition converts 2D/PDF floor plans to 3D models instantly
- [3D Model Importer – Bring Your Own Assets Into Planner 5D](https://planner5d.com/pro/import-3d-models): Import custom 3D models (.obj, .fbx, .blend, .stl) for enhanced designs
- [Hire Interior Designer Online – Professional 3D Interior Design Services](https://planner5d.com/experts): Professional interior design services marketplace connecting users with experts

## Visualization & Presentation Tools

- [Professional 360° Virtual Walkthroughs for Interior Design](https://planner5d.com/pro/360walkthrough): 360° virtual tour tool for immersive client presentations and design showcase
- [Free Online Mood Board Maker – Design, Plan & Inspire](https://planner5d.com/pro/moodboards): AI-powered mood board creation tool with collaboration features for designers

## Mobile Applications

- [Home Planning in Your Pocket - Planner 5D](https://planner5d.com/mobile/ios): iOS app for iPhone/iPad with 3D floor planning and furniture catalog
- [Home Planning in Your Pocket - Planner 5D](https://planner5d.com/mobile/android): Android app with 3D visualization, VR support, and furniture arrangement

## Desktop & Emerging Platforms

- [Plan with your PC - Planner 5D](https://planner5d.com/promo/windows): Windows PC application with HD rendering and offline design capabilities
- [Plan on your macOS - Planner 5D](https://planner5d.com/promo/macos): macOS application for home design with 3D visualization and rendering
- [Apple Vision Pro Apps for Interior Design - Planner 5D](https://planner5d.com/applevisionpro): Apple Vision Pro app for AR interior design and spatial computing
